task: Add a `context` subcommand to the llmc bench framework, per docs/plans/2026-08-19-context-occupancy-suite.md Tasks 3-4 (read the plan file first; it defines the sweep design, the symlinked-GGUF throwaway-preset pattern, occupancy headroom math, and result envelope). THE CHANGE: (1) llmc/bench/context.py - new module with fill_to_tokens(target, source, tokenize) plus the sweep driver: for each --ctx candidate, symlink the source preset's GGUF as ctx-sweep-<n>.gguf in the models volume, write models/ctx-sweep-<n>.toml (copy with overridden name/context_size/parallel_slots/[model].file), lock+spawn via the proxy, then for each occupancy fraction measure generation tokens/sec with filler sized to int(ctx*frac) - gen_tokens - 64 tokens via POST /tokenize, record a JSONL row {tag: context-occupancy, preset, ctx, slots, occupancy, prompt_tokens, completion_tokens, tg, vram_mib, llama_cpp pin, gpu, ts} to bench/results/runs.jsonl, then cleanup (unlock, delete TOML + symlink), and llmc switch back to the source preset at the end. (2) Register `context` in llmc/bench/cli.py NATIVE so `llmc bench context --preset qwen38 --ctx 196608 --occupancy 0.25 --gen-tokens 200 --dry-run` works; --dry-run prints the plan without touching docker. (3) llmc/tests/test_bench_context.py - unit tests: fill_to_tokens exact sizing with a fake tokenizer, throwaway TOML generation produces a unique model_id and parses via llmc.presets.load_preset, occupancy headroom math, cleanup ordering. ADD ONLY: do not modify existing tests or bench modules except the NATIVE registration line. CONVENTIONS: read llmc/bench/perf.py first and mirror its result-envelope + lock/unlock patterns exactly. The proxy at 127.0.0.1:11434 is the Go proxy (spec docs/specs/2026-08-19-model-proxy-v2.md).

sensors.name: go-gates
sensors.cmd: cd proxy-go && go build ./... && go vet ./... && go test ./... -race -count=1 2>&1

sensors.name: context-dry-run
sensors.cmd: export PATH="$PWD/bin:$PATH" && llmc bench context --preset qwen38 --ctx 196608 --occupancy 0.25 --gen-tokens 200 --dry-run

judge.spec: llmc bench context subcommand per the occupancy-suite plan. Accept: fill_to_tokens exact-sizing (unit-tested with fake tokenizer), throwaway presets use the symlinked-GGUF pattern with unique model_id (never duplicate model IDs), occupancy filler = int(ctx*frac) - gen_tokens - 64, results rows carry the full envelope (preset, ctx, occupancy, tg, vram, pin, gpu, ts) and land in bench/results/runs.jsonl, cleanup deletes throwaways and restores the source preset via llmc switch. Reject: whole-file rewrites of existing bench modules, modified pre-existing tests, hardcoded paths that break outside this repo, dry-run mode that touches docker or the proxy, scope creep beyond the context subcommand.

rules: ADD ONLY for tests - never modify or weaken existing tests
No new Python dependencies beyond the stdlib + what llmc already imports
